fields.label: Enable Collection
fields.description: Collectors write to Redis only; disable to stop collection.

fields.label: Storage and Export Mode
fields.description: Internal writes history to the site database. External skips DB history and exposes the optional Prometheus API. Both does both.

fields.label: Collection/Flush Interval (Seconds)
fields.description: Allowed range: 60 to 3600 seconds. A minute cron checks this interval.

fields.label: IP Storage
fields.description: Masked /24 IPv4 and /64 IPv6 networks are recommended. Full addresses are personal data.

fields.label: Prometheus Token SHA-256
fields.description: Only the SHA-256 digest is stored. Rotate a bearer token from the Observability Desk; the secret is shown once.

fields.label: Prometheus CIDR Allowlist
fields.description: Optional comma- or newline-separated CIDRs; empty permits any source with the correct token.

fields.label: Prometheus Metric Allowlist
fields.description: Optional comma- or newline-separated names from the supported counter/gauge list. No user or IP labels are exported.

fields.label: Metric Help Text (JSON)
fields.description: Optional JSON object mapping allowlisted metric names to Prometheus HELP text.

fields.label: Additional Log Roots (JSON)
fields.description: Optional list of absolute roots with scope site or bench. Bench roots are Administrator-only.

fields.label: Additional Redaction Patterns (JSON)
fields.description: Optional list of administrator-managed regular expressions applied to viewed lines.

fields.label: Download Confirmation Threshold (MB)
fields.description: Large raw or gzip log downloads require an explicit confirmation in Desk.

fields.label: Alert Recipients
fields.description: Comma- or newline-separated email addresses. Frappe's configured mail account is used.
